learningObjectives: Describe the purpose and components of the Explore Data landing page and Insights in Pega Platform.
Apply Insights across Case Views, Portal landing pages, and dashboards.

topics.title: Applying Insights across Pega Platform components

elements.text: Insights are like saved spreadsheet pivot configurations: you build the query once (pick fields, filters, chart type), save it with a name, and anyone with the right access can open that same 'view' of the data. The Explore Data landing page is the workbench where you build and store these configurations.

elements.description: A View-based landing page where you can explore and analyze application data. Query data, then sort, filter, and group results. It is the preferred data exploration tool for Constellation design system applications.

Rules that Pega Platform uses to transform data queries into tables or visualizations (lists or interactive charts). Insights can be saved and shared between users. Created via the Explore Data landing page.
Display a custom data query as a table on the Explore Data landing page. You can create a new table-based Insight or select a previously-created one to view or modify.
Visualize a custom data query as a chart (e.g., bar, line). You can create a new chart-based Insight or select a previously-created one to view or modify.

A chart sub-type providing a high-level summary of data. To configure: in the Fields section, select fields in the Measures area ONLY. The Display as list then updates to include simple value options.
For apps built with Traditional UI architecture, you must enable the option to 'use Constellation UI to render landing pages' before you can use Explore Data.

elements.term: Insights in full Page Case Views
elements.description: Add Insights to tabs in a full Page Case View. The source explicitly excludes adding them directly to a View. For example, the Order Details tab can show an order-trend chart.
Use the Portal configuration pane to place an existing public Insight in a landing-page region alongside fields, Views and Widgets. Add the landing page to Portal navigation for discoverability.

Dashboards arrange multiple Insights using templates. The Dashboards landing page lists available dashboards, including Work metrics. It is available by default in App Studio and Work Portals and is not configured through the Portal authoring page.

items: Shared with Access Group: visible to members of that Access Group

elements.description: A filter added to a dashboard that applies across ALL Insights in that dashboard. Helps users refine data views across multiple Insights simultaneously. Example: adding 'Item Category' filter to a dashboard with 3 sales Insights.

examPitfalls.title: Insights are Rules, not just queries
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Insights are saved Rules created from data queries; being a saved query and being a Rule are compatible descriptions. The source does not detail an Insight version-resolution algorithm.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Insights are saved Rules in Pega Platform that transform data queries into persistent, shareable tables or visualizations.

examPitfalls.title: Explore Data is Constellation-only by default
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A question asks which applications can use the Explore Data landing page. Candidates say 'all Pega applications.' Explore Data is available by default only in Constellation UI — traditional portals require custom configuration.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Traditional UI apps must enable 'use Constellation UI to render landing pages' to access Explore Data.

examPitfalls.title: Simple value chart requires Measures area fields ONLY
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A question describes a Simple Value chart and asks which field areas are required. Candidates add a Group By field expecting it to work like a bar chart. Simple Value charts use only the Measures area — a Group By field is not supported.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: For a simple value chart, select fields in the Measures area ONLY — adding Dimensions prevents the simple value display type from appearing.

examPitfalls.title: Promoted filter applies to ALL Insights in the dashboard
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A question asks what happens when a user changes a promoted filter in a dashboard. Candidates say 'only the widget that owns the filter updates.' A promoted filter is shared — changing it re-filters ALL Insights in that dashboard simultaneously.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Promoted filters apply across the dashboard’s Insights. Do not extend that claim to every Widget regardless of its content.

examPitfalls.title: Dashboard visibility: 3 options
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Do not confuse dashboard visibility with the source data’s permissions. The topic names Private, Shared with Access Group and Public.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Private = only you. Shared with Access Group = members of that group. Public = all users in the application.

examPitfalls.title: Missing columns require configuration checks, not automatic permission expansion
examPitfalls.trapDescription: The source identifies property optimization, relevant records and browser state. Treating every missing column as a permission problem can lead to unnecessary access changes.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Check optimization in parent/specific classes, relevant-record configuration and stale browser state; investigate permissions only when there is evidence.

examPitfalls.title: Insights can be added to Case Views AND Portal pages AND Dashboards
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A question asks where Insights can be embedded. Candidates limit the answer to dashboards. Insights can be placed in Case Views, Portal pages, and Dashboards — all three are valid destinations.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Insights can be embedded in: full Page Case View tabs, Portal landing page regions (alongside fields/Views/Widgets), and Dashboards.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A business analyst asks a Pega System Architect to explain what Insights are and how they differ from the traditional Pega Report Browser reports they have used in previous projects. What are Insights in Pega Platform?

options.text: Rules that transform data queries into tables or visualizations that can be shared between users
Ad-hoc database queries that run once and are not saved
Reports configured in Admin Studio for system administrators
Data Pages that cache application data for offline use

practiceQuiz.hint: Insights in Pega are persistent, savable, and shareable reporting artifacts across the platform.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Insights are Rules presenting queries as shareable tables or charts.

optionExplanations.A: Insights are Rules presenting queries as shareable tables or charts.
optionExplanations.B: Queries can be saved as Insights rather than being one-time only.
optionExplanations.C: Insights are not described as administrator-only Admin Studio reports.
optionExplanations.D: An Insight is not the offline cache Data Page described here.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A developer wants to use the Explore Data landing page in an application built with Traditional UI architecture. What must they do first?

options.text: Enable the option to use Constellation UI to render landing pages
Install a separate Explore Data module from the Pega Marketplace
Switch the entire application to Constellation UI architecture
Nothing — Explore Data works in all UI architectures by default

practiceQuiz.hint: Explore Data is a Constellation-based tool that needs to be enabled for Traditional UI apps.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Enable Constellation rendering of landing pages in Traditional UI.

optionExplanations.A: Enable Constellation rendering of landing pages in Traditional UI.
optionExplanations.B: The source does not require a separate Marketplace module.
optionExplanations.C: It does not require converting the entire application architecture.
optionExplanations.D: The source states a rendering option must be enabled first.

practiceQuiz.scenario: You need a Simple Value chart displaying total revenue without category grouping. Which configuration matches the source?

options.text: Chart-based Insight — simple value chart — select fields in the Measures area only
Chart-based Insight — bar chart — select fields in both Measures and Dimensions
Table-based Insight — add a summary row at the bottom
Chart-based Insight — simple value chart — select fields in the Dimensions area only

practiceQuiz.hint: A simple single-value chart configuration uses only the Measures area — no grouping needed.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Measures-only selection exposes the Simple Value display option.

optionExplanations.A: Measures-only selection exposes the Simple Value display option.
optionExplanations.B: Category grouping is outside this no-grouping requirement.
optionExplanations.C: A table summary is not the requested Simple Value chart.
optionExplanations.D: Dimensions-only selection is not the source’s configuration.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A user wants to add an Insight to the Details tab of an Order Case Type so managers can see product order trends while reviewing a case. Where should the developer configure this?

options.text: In the full Page Case View, add the Insight to the tab
On the Explore Data landing page, link the Insight to the Case Type
In the Dashboard configuration, assign the Insight to the Case Type
In Admin Studio, configure the Insight under Case Management

practiceQuiz.hint: Insights can be embedded in Case View tabs.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Add the Insight to a full Page Case View tab.

optionExplanations.A: Add the Insight to a full Page Case View tab.
optionExplanations.B: Explore Data creates/manages Insights rather than this placement.
optionExplanations.C: Dashboard configuration is not placement in the Order Details tab.
optionExplanations.D: This Admin Studio route is not the one in the source.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A developer is configuring a Portal landing page and wants to add an Insight alongside existing fields and Widgets. Where are available landing pages displayed for this configuration?

options.text: In the Portal configuration pane
In the Explore Data landing page sidebar
In Admin Studio under Channel Interfaces
In App Studio under Settings > Landing Pages

practiceQuiz.hint: Portal configuration for Insights has its own dedicated configuration panel in the portal.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The Portal configuration pane lists the available landing pages.

optionExplanations.A: The Portal configuration pane lists the available landing pages.
optionExplanations.B: Explore Data manages Insights rather than listing these authoring regions.
optionExplanations.C: Admin Studio Channel Interfaces is not this source procedure.
optionExplanations.D: The source does not give this Settings path for this task.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A dashboard contains 3 sales Insights. A manager wants to filter all three by Item Category simultaneously. What should you configure?

options.text: A promoted filter on the dashboard with the Item Category field
A When Rule on each Insight to filter by Item Category
Three separate filters — one on each Insight
A global Data Page filtered by Item Category

practiceQuiz.hint: One filter type applies across all Insights in a dashboard.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A promoted filter addresses the dashboard’s Insights together.

optionExplanations.A: A promoted filter addresses the dashboard’s Insights together.
optionExplanations.B: Separate When Rules are not the dashboard filter described here.
optionExplanations.C: Separate filters do not provide the requested shared control.
optionExplanations.D: A global Data Page is not the documented dashboard filter.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A developer belongs to the Sales Managers Access Group and wants to share the dashboard with that group. Which visibility choice matches the source?

options.text: Shared with Access Group
Private
Public
Restricted

practiceQuiz.hint: Dashboard sharing supports the Access Group audience; visibility is distinct from data permissions.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Shared with Access Group selects the requested group audience.

optionExplanations.A: Shared with Access Group selects the requested group audience.
optionExplanations.B: Private restricts visibility to the creator rather than the group.
optionExplanations.C: Public exposes the dashboard to all application users.
optionExplanations.D: Restricted is not one of the three visibility names here.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Users report being prompted to log in repeatedly when working with Insights. What is the likely cause and fix?

options.text: Inappropriate access token lifetime — update the token lifetime
Missing Insight permissions — grant access to all Insights
Browser cache issue — clear the cache
Constellation UI not enabled — enable Constellation UI rendering

practiceQuiz.hint: Frequent token expiry causes repeated login prompts — token lifetime is likely set too short.
practiceQuiz.rationale: An inappropriate token lifetime can cause repeated prompts.

optionExplanations.A: An inappropriate token lifetime can cause repeated prompts.
optionExplanations.B: Granting every Insight is not the token-lifetime remedy.
optionExplanations.C: Cache can cause other issues, but is not this source’s token example.
optionExplanations.D: Rendering configuration is not the token-expiry remedy described.

practiceQuiz.scenario: According to the troubleshooting topic, what UI change addresses confusing number separators in Insight tables?

options.text: Modify the UI controls to remove the number separators
Recreate the Insight with a different field configuration
Change the user's locale settings
Use a chart-based Insight instead of a table-based Insight

practiceQuiz.hint: The fix for a display formatting issue is a UI control modification, not a data change.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Modify UI controls to remove the separators as the topic recommends.

optionExplanations.A: Modify UI controls to remove the separators as the topic recommends.
optionExplanations.B: Recreating the Insight is not the source’s formatting remedy.
optionExplanations.C: The topic recommends a control change rather than this locale remedy.
optionExplanations.D: Switching visualization type does not implement the stated table remedy.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A column is absent from the Show/hide columns list in Explore Data. What source-backed configuration should you check?

options.text: Optimize the backing property in parent classes and in the specific Class being viewed
Whether the application server needs a restart to refresh data
Whether the browser cache needs to be cleared
Whether the Insight needs to be reconfigured to add the missing columns

practiceQuiz.hint: Absence from Show/hide columns points to the backing property’s reporting optimization.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The source requires optimization in parent and specific classes.

optionExplanations.A: The source requires optimization in parent and specific classes.
optionExplanations.B: A server restart does not replace backing-property optimization.
optionExplanations.C: Browser state can matter, but does not optimize the backing property.
optionExplanations.D: Adding the column again does not address its reporting optimization.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A user's Explore Data landing page shows an object with a wrong name in the list. What is the root cause and fix?

options.text: Pega sources names from the class short description — update the short description
The Insight Rule name is incorrect — rename the Rule
The Data Page label needs to be updated
The Portal configuration is pointing to the wrong Insight

practiceQuiz.hint: Pega uses a specific class property as the display name.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The source uses the class short description for the object display name.

optionExplanations.A: The source uses the class short description for the object display name.
optionExplanations.B: Renaming the Insight does not change that class-sourced name.
optionExplanations.C: Changing a Data Page label does not update the stated class source.
optionExplanations.D: Portal Insight selection is not the stated object-name source.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which THREE locations does the source describe for embedding an existing Insight?

options.text: A tab in a full Page Case View
A region of a Portal landing page
A Dashboard
Directly inside an arbitrary View, without a full Page Case View tab

practiceQuiz.hint: Three out of four are valid Insight embedding locations.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A full Page Case View tab is a supported placement. A Portal landing-page region is a supported placement. Dashboard placement is also supported by the source.

optionExplanations.A: A full Page Case View tab is a supported placement.
optionExplanations.B: A Portal landing-page region is a supported placement.
optionExplanations.C: Dashboard placement is also supported by the source.
optionExplanations.D: The source explicitly excludes adding an Insight directly to a View.

practiceQuiz.scenario: An SA is explaining the Explore Data landing page to a business analyst. Which TWO statements correctly describe its purpose and capabilities?

options.text: The Explore Data landing page provides a central interface for creating and managing Insights from application Case data
Insights can be placed in full Page Case View tabs, Portal landing pages and dashboards
The Explore Data landing page replaces the Pega Report Browser and permanently deletes all existing Report Definitions
Insights are exclusively accessible to System Administrators and cannot be shared with business analysts

practiceQuiz.hint: Explore Data centralizes Insight creation; Insights are embeddable across Case Views, dashboards, and landing pages.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Explore Data creates and manages Insights from application data. These are the documented tab, landing-page and dashboard placements.

optionExplanations.A: Explore Data creates and manages Insights from application data.
optionExplanations.B: These are the documented tab, landing-page and dashboard placements.
optionExplanations.C: The source does not describe deleting existing Report Definitions.
optionExplanations.D: Insights can be shared between users rather than being admin-only.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO source-backed property configuration checks address missing Explore Data columns?

options.text: Verify reporting optimization of the backing property in parent classes and the specific Class
Check whether the property is a relevant record; mark it relevant in Dev Studio when appropriate
Delete and reimport the entire application Ruleset to reset all Insight configurations to defaults
Disable all other Insights in the application to isolate whether another Insight is causing a data conflict

practiceQuiz.hint: Distinguish property configuration checks from destructive resets or broad feature disabling.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Optimization in the parent/specific classes is a documented check. Relevant-record configuration is another documented column check.

optionExplanations.A: Optimization in the parent/specific classes is a documented check.
optionExplanations.B: Relevant-record configuration is another documented column check.
optionExplanations.C: Reimporting the application is not the prescribed property remedy.
optionExplanations.D: Disabling other Insights does not configure the missing property.
